# L3 Operational Hardening — Push (Continuation Nudge)

## Purpose

This file is used AS-IS as a continuation nudge during L3 execution. Paste it into a fresh session when an agent needs to pick up where the last one left off.

**Do NOT modify this file.** It is generated by step 10 and used verbatim.

**The actual push prompt lives at:**
```
docs/pipeline/l3-operational-hardening/artifacts/l3-operational-hardening-push.md
```

## When to Use

- Agent session ended (context limit, timeout, manual stop)
- Starting a new agent session for L3 work
- After resolving a blocker and resuming

## How to Use

1. Open `docs/pipeline/l3-operational-hardening/artifacts/l3-operational-hardening-push.md`
2. Paste the ENTIRE content into a fresh Claude Code session
3. The agent will: check inbox, run `br ready`, claim a bead, implement, verify, commit, push, loop

---

## Quick Push (if the artifact file doesn't exist yet)

Paste this into a fresh session:

```
Re-read AGENTS.md fully.

You are working on L3 Operational Hardening for a UK public procurement intelligence platform.

Project key: /Users/alinaaitova/Desktop/Testproject1

1. Finish any in-progress work first (check `br list --status=in_progress`).
2. Check inbox: `fetch_inbox(project_key, agent_name, include_bodies=true)`
3. Run `br ready --json` — pick the highest-priority ready bead.
4. For each bead:
   - Claim: `br update <id> --status=in_progress`
   - Reserve files: `file_reservation_paths(project_key, agent_name, paths=[...], ttl_seconds=3600, exclusive=true, reason="<bead-id>")`
   - Announce: `send_message(project_key, sender_name, to=["all"], subject="[<bead-id>] Claimed: ...", ack_required=true)`
   - Read the bead: `br show <id>` — it is self-contained with spec + TDD content
   - Implement the bead
   - Run quality gates:
     cargo check --all-targets
     cargo test
     cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
     cargo fmt --check
     bun run build && bun run test && bun run lint  # if TS files changed
     ubs $(git diff --name-only --cached)
   - Commit with bead ID prefix
   - git push
   - Release: `release_file_reservations(project_key, agent_name)`
   - Announce: `send_message(project_key, sender_name, to=["all"], subject="[<bead-id>] Complete")`
   - Close: `br close <id>`
   - Loop to next ready bead

Do NOT stop to ask what to work on. Do NOT wait for permission.
If fully blocked: push all work, release reservations, bin/br-sync, announce handoff via mail.
```
